name: Godrej Regent Park
description: Godrej Regent Park is a new-launch development of 2 & 3 BHK apartments in Kada Agrahara, off Sarjapur Road, designed with Victorian-inspired architecture. The master plan sets two towers around 32 amenity zones, a short drive from the Wipro Sarjapur campus and the Outer Ring Road.
curation: Victorian-inspired architecture with arched arcades and formal landscaped gardens
About 10 minutes to the Wipro Sarjapur campus and 12 to RGA Tech Park
DMart Sarjapur within walking distance, and Azim Premji University about 5 minutes away
connectivity: Outer Ring Road about 5 to 10 minutes
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: Twin residential towers rising above landscaped greens
